$comment: nodes=modules, edges=[cause,effect] where cause is imported-by effect. Nodes/edges SEEDED BY HAND from the G0 architecture (repo was empty; graphizer found 0 nodes). Invariants are hand-written health rules. WARNING: `graphizer.mjs --write` overwrites this whole file including invariants — use scripts/regraph.sh instead.

dependency_direction_inward.rule: core/ imports nothing from the project. Outer modules import inward only. No module outside orchestrator/langgraph_engine.py may import langgraph; no module outside memory/ and database/ may import asyncpg or sqlalchemy. Zero import cycles.
dependency_direction_inward.why: ADR-002 modular monolith + the ADR-001 seam. If langgraph leaks past langgraph_engine.py, the Temporal swap stops being a one-file change.

every_outbound_call_bounded.rule: Every call leaving the process — LLM provider, GitHub API, Postgres, Redis — has an explicit timeout AND retry-with-backoff AND circuit breaker. No bare await on a network client.
every_outbound_call_bounded.why: L8 tool/API-timeout and orchestration-deadlock modes. An unbounded call is how the aggregator join hangs forever.

no_finding_without_evidence.rule: Every Finding has a non-empty rationale, a confidence in [0.0,1.0], and a file_path/line that resolves to a line actually present in the PR diff or in retrieved context. A finding about a file the agent never saw is rejected before it reaches the aggregator.
no_finding_without_evidence.why: L4/L6. This is the hallucination-in-critical-path defense made computable — it is what makes a finding disputable instead of merely confident.

every_action_emits_an_event.rule: No LLM call, tool call, or agent span completes without a matching agent_events row carrying cost_usd, latency_ms, model, and span_id/parent_span. The events table is append-only — no UPDATE or DELETE against agent_events anywhere in the codebase.
every_action_emits_an_event.why: L6. If the system cannot show its work it has not done the work; the trace viewer, audit trail, and cost ledger are all one query against this table.

budget_guard_blocks_before_spend.rule: BudgetGuard reads the day's running cost from agent_health_1m at the top of every agent run and hard-blocks BEFORE the LLM call when the daily cap is exceeded. Never after.
budget_guard_blocks_before_spend.why: ADR-004. A cost check that runs after the call is a cost report, not a cap.

untrusted_input_never_gains_instruction_.rule: PR diff content and retrieved code chunks are wrapped as data under an explicit instruction hierarchy; they can never introduce, override, or terminate system instructions. The injection guard runs on every specialist prompt.
untrusted_input_never_gains_instruction_.why: The trust boundary from G0 — the diff is attacker-controlled and flows straight into four LLM prompts.
